meta.name: Pujo Parikrama
meta.disclaimer: Locations and details are curated and approximate. Themes, timings and traffic rules change every year, so check locally.

zones.name: Kumartuli, Bagbazar & Hatibagan
zones.vibe: Bonedi bari, Kumartuli artisans, and the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Narrow lanes, deep tradition.
zones.walk_tip: Take the Blue Line to Sovabazar or Shyambazar. The lanes off Rabindra Sarani and Bidhan Sarani are closed to cars most evenings.

zones.name: College Street & Sealdah
zones.vibe: Theme giants: Md. Ali Park, College Square and Santosh Mitra Square. Huge queues and huge spectacle.
zones.walk_tip: Use MG Road, Central or Sealdah. Go before 8 am or after 1 am if you want short queues.

zones.name: Gariahat & Ballygunge
zones.vibe: Ekdalia, Singhi Park and Ballygunge Cultural. Classic South Kolkata grandeur with lots of food around.
zones.walk_tip: Park at South City or Quest and walk the Gariahat loop. Gariahat Road becomes one-way after 4 pm.

zones.name: Lake Market & Kalighat
zones.vibe: Tridhara, 66 Pally, Maddox Square, Badamtala and Chetla. The densest cluster in the city.
zones.walk_tip: The Blue Line stations Kalighat, Rabindra Sarobar and Jatin Das Park all drop you right into the cluster. Lake Mall has paid parking.

zones.name: Behala & New Alipore
zones.vibe: Suruchi Sangha, Barisha and Behala Notun Dal. Theme-heavy and a little less crowded.
zones.walk_tip: The Purple Line runs from Taratala to Behala Chowrasta. Cars are fine before 5 pm.

zones.name: Salt Lake
zones.vibe: FD, BJ and AE Blocks. Wide roads, well organised, family friendly.
zones.walk_tip: Green Line to City Centre. Cars are OK, and City Centre has paid parking.

zones.name: Lake Town & Dum Dum
zones.vibe: Sreebhumi and the Dum Dum Park theme row. Insta-famous replicas and art installations.
zones.walk_tip: VIP Road jams up for kilometres around Sreebhumi. Take the metro to Dum Dum and then an auto, or park at Diamond Plaza.

zones.name: Bhowanipore & Elgin
zones.vibe: Maddox Square adda, Bakulbagan, Chakraberia and 75 Pally. Old South Kolkata paras.
zones.walk_tip: Jatin Das Park and Netaji Bhavan metro stations put you right in the middle. Forum Mall has paid parking.

zones.name: Kasba & Bosepukur
zones.vibe: The Bosepukur pujas and Rajdanga, famous for pandals made of unusual materials.
zones.walk_tip: Take the Orange Line to Ruby (Hemanta Mukhopadhyay), or an auto from Gariahat.

zones.name: Jadavpur & Santoshpur
zones.vibe: Selimpur, Santoshpur Lake Pally and Trikon Park. A dense cluster of theme pujas.
zones.walk_tip: Autos run from Gariahat to Jadavpur (8B). Jadavpur and Dhakuria suburban stations are close.

zones.name: Tollygunge & Naktala
zones.vibe: Naktala Udayan Sangha and the pujas along the Blue Line south.
zones.walk_tip: Blue Line to Gitanjali or Netaji. Autos run from Tollygunge Phari.

zones.name: Beleghata & Phoolbagan
zones.vibe: Neighbourhood theme pujas between Sealdah and Salt Lake.
zones.walk_tip: Green Line to Phoolbagan, or the Orange Line to Beleghata.

zones.name: Baguiati & Kestopur
zones.vibe: The Arjunpur and Kestopur theme pujas off VIP Road.
zones.walk_tip: VIP Road jams in the evening. Autos and buses run from Ultadanga and Baguiati.

zones.name: Howrah: Shibpur & Salkia
zones.vibe: Old Howrah pujas across the river, with a quieter, local feel.
zones.walk_tip: Take the Green Line under the river to Howrah, or a ferry from the ghats, then an auto or toto.

parking.name: Noapara Metro (Park & Ride)
parking.note: Leave the car here and ride the Blue Line to Shyambazar or Sovabazar.

parking.name: Dum Dum Metro Area (Park & Ride)
parking.note: Ride the metro south, or take an auto to Dum Dum Park.

parking.name: Hatibagan Pay & Park (Bidhan Sarani)
parking.note: Usually closed after 4 pm on the main puja days. Check the KP advisory.

parking.name: Sealdah Station Parking
parking.note: The best car base for Santosh Mitra and Sealdah RAC.

parking.name: New Market Multi-level Parking
parking.note: Walk or take the metro north from Esplanade.

parking.name: Lake Mall (Rashbehari)
parking.note: Right in the Tridhara–Deshapriya–66 Pally cluster. Fills by 6 pm.

parking.name: Forum Mall (Elgin Road)
parking.note: A good base for Maddox Square and Bhowanipore.

parking.name: Quest Mall (Ballygunge Circular Rd)
parking.note: Take a cab or the metro south to the Gariahat cluster.

parking.name: South City Mall
parking.note: The base for Jodhpur Park and Babubagan. A cab to Ekdalia takes about 10 minutes.

parking.name: Behala Bazar Metro (Purple Line)
parking.note: Close to Behala Notun Dal and Sahajatri.

parking.name: New Alipore Police-marked Street Parking
parking.note: Follow the cones. Suruchi Sangha is a 5-minute walk.

parking.name: City Centre 1 Parking
parking.note: Walk to FD Block, or take a short auto to BJ Block.

parking.name: Central Park Salt Lake (Puja Lot)
parking.note: A temporary lot that usually opens on the puja days.

parking.name: Diamond Plaza (Jessore Road)
parking.note: Leave the car here. VIP Road near Sreebhumi stays jammed for hours.

itineraries.name: North Kolkata Heritage Trail
itineraries.blurb: Kumartuli, Bagbazar, the bonedi bari and Hatibagan, finishing with kabiraji at Mitra Cafe.
itineraries.blurb_bn: কুমোরটুলি, বাগবাজার, বনেদি বাড়ি আর হাতিবাগান। শেষে মিত্র ক্যাফের কবিরাজি।

itineraries.name: Central Blockbusters at Dawn
itineraries.blurb: Md. Ali Park and Santosh Mitra Square before the queues wake up, then kochuri at Putiram.
itineraries.blurb_bn: লাইন পড়ার আগে মহম্মদ আলি পার্ক আর সন্তোষ মিত্র স্কোয়ার। তারপর পুঁটিরামের কচুরি।

itineraries.name: South Heavyweights
itineraries.blurb: Chetla, Tridhara, 66 Pally and Maddox, then over to Ekdalia and Singhi Park. Phuchka on the way.
itineraries.blurb_bn: চেতলা, ত্রিধারা, ৬৬ পল্লী, ম্যাডক্স, তারপর একডালিয়া আর সিংহী পার্ক। পথে ফুচকা।

itineraries.name: Behala & New Alipore Theme Trail
itineraries.name_bn: বেহালা ও নিউ আলিপুর থিম পরিক্রমা
itineraries.blurb: Suruchi's state-art theme, then the Behala theme strip by the Purple Line.
itineraries.blurb_bn: সুরুচির রাজ্য-শিল্পের থিম, তারপর পার্পল লাইন ধরে বেহালার থিম পুজো।

itineraries.name: Salt Lake + Lake Town Hop
itineraries.blurb: Family-friendly blocks, then the Sreebhumi spectacle once the evening rush thins.
itineraries.blurb_bn: পরিবারের জন্য সল্টলেকের ব্লক, সন্ধের ভিড় কমলে শ্রীভূমি।

itineraries.name: The All-Nighter: North → South
itineraries.blurb: Only the five-star pandals. Ride the Blue Line between clusters and walk till dawn.
itineraries.blurb_bn: শুধু পাঁচ-তারা পুজো। ব্লু লাইনে চড়ে ক্লাস্টার বদলান, ভোর পর্যন্ত হাঁটুন।
